name: case-brief
title: Internal support case brief
for_each: select id,subject from tickets order by subject

sections.title: Ticket
sections.sql: select t.subject,c.name as customer,t.requester,t.assignee,t.status,t.priority,t.description from tickets t join customers c on c.id=t.customer_id where t.id=$1

sections.title: Recorded history
sections.note: Internal working document. Review before sharing. Imported CSV does not contain the original conversation.
sections.sql: select kind,body,actor,occurred_at from notes where ticket_id=$1 order by occurred_at

name: escalation-sheet
title: Internal escalation action sheet
for_each: select id,subject from tickets where exists(select 1 from escalations e where e.ticket_id=tickets.id) order by subject

sections.title: Actions and outcome
sections.sql: select reason,owner,due_at,resolution,resolved_at from escalations where ticket_id=$1 order by due_at

name: service-review
title: Customer service review
for_each: select id,name from customers order by name

sections.title: Recorded outcomes
sections.note: All-time metrics on available records. Calendar hours, not business hours. Missing reply history is excluded from averages.

sections.title: Open support cases
sections.sql: select subject,status,priority,assignee,reply_due_at,resolution_due_at from tickets where customer_id=$1 and status not in ('solved','closed') order by opened_at
